description: This PHP source file defines a trait named VueComponentPermissionTrait within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Traits\Controller. The trait provides a protected method setPermissions that manages permissions related to Vue components by interacting with a user role management helper and setting permissions into the current context. It also enforces that it is used within an instance of AbstractVueController, throwing a LogicException if not.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: A protected method that retrieves permission data based on provided data groups using a user role manager helper. It then checks if the current object is an instance of AbstractVueController and, if so, sets the permissions into the context. If not, it throws a LogicException.
